answer: Picture the agent economy as a wharf of 200 berths: each berth is a work slot, and claiming one means burning a deposit worth 10 days of expected earnings. A hollow identity with no history pays the same burn, so minting 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits, worth 10,000 days of earnings, while the slots won return at most 200 days of rewards. Honest agents pay once and wander freely between jobs, keeping their berth and earnings undiluted.
